audit: MineUAV RL Baseline v1 robustness attribution; inference only
tail_definition: Equal weight per episode: pre-command world-frame states in the last available 5 s or 1 s. Position error = target minus position. Actual span and sample count are stored per episode; short successes are not padded.
metric_caveat: Some hold probes end on safety limits before 15 s; their tail windows describe late-stage drift, not equilibrium. A zero crossing rate can mean the aircraft never entered the near-target region. Tail means from successful episodes may include their final approach, so timeout-only tail metrics are provided separately. Ground contact can make vertical speed small despite a large position error.

attribution_interpretation.interpretation: Both high-level policies issue persistent nonzero compensating velocity commands at all six stress levels, while actual axial velocity is near zero and a large position error remains. Together with zero-command hold drift and shared task failures, this supports inadequate low-level static-disturbance rejection as the primary bottleneck; policy-dependent success margins still exist.
attribution_interpretation.scope: Only the tested waypoint distribution, five frozen PPO seeds, scripted policy, and six ±5%/±5 N levels are classified.
